zh.title: 子代理委派全灭热修与工具调用协议加固
highlights: 热修：v3.35.0 / v3.36.0 中 delegate_task / delegate_batch / galaxy 全部子代理调用必然失败（parsePrompt 段间分隔符缺陷），重启无效——本版修复解析器，按原文记录每段真实分隔符并补回归用例。
主控提示词只点名实际提供的工具：默认档位下提示词不再命令模型调用未提供的 apply_patch 等工具，消除整次响应作废的 ToolNameProtocolError(unknown)；兼容网关 functions.<工具名> 包装并独立 tool_protocol 错误类。
续跑与锁稳定：缺 wireTransformVersion 的 legacy 证明不再静默替换 transport 基线；睡眠唤醒/改主机名后的 stale 锁恢复；收编公开仓 PR #531 会话命令工作流。

en.title: Hotfix for the total subagent delegation outage, plus tool-call protocol hardening
highlights: Hotfix: in v3.35.0 / v3.36.0 every subagent call (delegate_task / delegate_batch / galaxy) failed deterministically with a parsePrompt section-separator defect, and restarts could not help — the parser now preserves each section's exact separator, with a regression test.

The main-controller prompt now names only provided tools: it no longer tells the model to call apply_patch on presets where it is gated out, which aborted responses with ToolNameProtocolError(unknown); gateway functions.<name> wrapping is normalized, with a dedicated tool_protocol error category.

Resume and lock stability: legacy proofs missing wireTransformVersion can no longer silently replace the transport baseline; stale lock owners recover after sleep/hostname changes; community PR #531 session command workflow adopted.
